title: Ferrocarriles, puertos y mercados
goal: Read how foreign-owned railways, ports and companies formed "enclave economies" -- and how a British businessman came to influence Chilean politics without ever holding office.

items: Explain who typically built and financed Latin American railways.
Define what historians mean by an "enclave economy."
Describe John Thomas North's role in Chile's nitrate industry.
Explain what the region's growing ports mainly served to do.
Use aunque + subjunctive to concede a point while making a larger argument.
